actions.summary: Supply the unresolved official-source bytes through the controlled handoff with source identity, provenance and permission to retain them.
prerequisites: authorized access to the official publisher or custodian
exact source identity and acquisition request
evidence_required: source URL or custodian reference and acquisition timestamp
actions.completion_effect: Permits controlled import and re-verification only; it does not activate a legal source.

actions.summary: An identified legal reviewer must inspect the exact source bytes and sign the authority, completeness and content decision for each affected topic.
prerequisites: eligible controlled-import receipt from OA-01
registered reviewer organization, policy and active signing key
separation from the importer role
actions.completion_effect: Permits source-lifecycle eligibility re-verification only; it does not activate a source.

actions.summary: A trusted applicability reviewer must sign the effective period, sector, population, geography and exception scope bound to the exact reviewed source version.
prerequisites: completed source-content decision from OA-02
independent applicability reviewer identity and active signing key
exact source version and citation anchors
evidence_required: exact effective-period, sector, population and geography scope
actions.completion_effect: Permits applicability-gate re-verification only; it does not activate a source, parameter or rule.

actions.summary: A first trusted verifier must independently attest the exact parameter payload and its source and applicability bindings.
prerequisites: eligible source and applicability decisions from OA-02 and OA-03
active verifier identity and signing key
exact parameter candidate hash and derivation citations
evidence_required: exact parameter candidate and content SHA-256
source, period, sector, population and geography bindings
actions.completion_effect: Records only the first attestation; it does not satisfy dual attestation or activate a parameter.

actions.summary: A second distinct trusted verifier must independently attest the same exact parameter payload and bindings.
prerequisites: completed first attestation from OA-04
a verifier identity distinct from OA-04
the unchanged exact parameter candidate and binding hashes
evidence_required: exact parameter and dependency hashes matching OA-04
actions.completion_effect: Permits dual-attestation eligibility re-verification only; it does not activate a parameter or approve rule semantics.

actions.summary: A trusted legal reviewer must approve the completed non-operative RuleSpec semantics against its exact sources, parameters, citations and package digest.
prerequisites: eligible sources and dual-attested parameters
completed nonblank RuleSpec
reviewer separated from authorship and parameter attestations
evidence_required: source, parameter, period and scope dependency hashes
actions.completion_effect: Permits RuleSpec lifecycle re-verification only; it does not activate a rule or create a Finding.

actions.summary: Human authors must complete the blank golden cases and independent reviewers must approve every expected result against the exact RuleSpec and case hashes.
prerequisites: RuleSpec approval candidate from OA-06
completed nonblank cases covering required scenarios and boundaries
independent expected-result reviewers
evidence_required: signed expected result for every golden case
mutation report bound to the reviewed set
actions.completion_effect: Permits golden-case and RuleSpec eligibility re-verification only; templates alone never count as human-reviewed cases.

actions.summary: A trusted reviewer must approve provenance, license, PII scope and visual eligibility for the exact immutable document bytes before annotation.
prerequisites: document license or authorization
approved PII-handling scope
verified visual rendering of the exact immutable bytes
actions.completion_effect: Permits annotation eligibility re-verification for that document only; it does not lock Ground Truth or authorize other customer reads.

actions.summary: The first blind annotator must submit a sealed annotation bound to the exact eligible document and schema revision.
prerequisites: eligible visual-review decision from OA-08
active annotator identity and signing key
no access to another annotation pass
actions.completion_effect: Records only annotation pass 1; it does not establish or lock Ground Truth.

actions.summary: A second distinct blind annotator must independently submit a sealed annotation for the same exact document and schema revision.
prerequisites: eligible visual-review decision from OA-08
annotator identity distinct from OA-09
no access to annotation pass 1
evidence_required: document, rendering and schema hashes matching OA-09
actions.completion_effect: Records only annotation pass 2 and enables disagreement construction; it does not lock Ground Truth.

actions.summary: A distinct adjudicator must resolve every structured disagreement and sign the exact immutable Ground Truth lock revision.
prerequisites: sealed annotation passes from OA-09 and OA-10
structured disagreement set
adjudicator identity distinct from both annotators
actions.completion_effect: Permits lock verification for the exact authorized revision only; later correction requires a new superseding revision.

actions.summary: Deliver the actual deterministic evidence-package bytes to an identified independent auditor through an authorized channel.
prerequisites: final deterministic evidence package and detached verifier
identified auditor and agreed delivery channel
explicit authority to transfer the package bytes
evidence_required: zero substitution between built and delivered bytes
actions.completion_effect: Completes delivery evidence only; it does not prove independent verification or authorize production.

actions.summary: The independent auditor must verify the actual received bytes and return a signed decision bound to them.
prerequisites: completed authorized delivery from OA-12
auditor access to the actual package bytes
active auditor identity and signing key
actions.completion_effect: Completes external evidence verification only; it does not authorize production delivery.

actions.summary: Provide an authorized isolated nonproduction managed identity issuer, key source, rotation policy and durable session-state service.
prerequisites: authorized managed-platform account and isolated nonproduction environment
approved issuer and key ownership
scoped nonproduction credentials
actions.completion_effect: Permits isolated managed-identity verification only; it does not authorize deployment or customer processing.

actions.summary: Provide an authorized isolated nonproduction private object-store tenancy and prove owner-scoped policy, immutability and revocation behavior.
prerequisites: authorized managed-platform account and isolated nonproduction storage
approved encryption and retention ownership
scoped nonproduction service credentials
actions.completion_effect: Permits isolated managed-storage verification only; it does not authorize production storage or customer processing.

actions.summary: The data controller, privacy and security owners, and an authorized customer representative must approve the exact dataset, purpose, retention, access roles and stop conditions for Customer Shadow.
prerequisites: documented legal basis and customer authorization for the exact dataset
privacy and security risk approval
approved retention, deletion, incident and revocation procedures
independent operational reviewer and kill-switch owner
evidence_required: signed authorization bound to dataset manifest and purpose
actions.completion_effect: Permits a separate authorization-gate re-verification only; it does not authorize Customer Shadow by itself.

actions.summary: Provide an already installed local Supabase CLI and local container engine with the complete cached image family in an unlinked, credential-scrubbed environment.
prerequisites: owned local-only runtime
no linked project or remote credentials
complete cached images with no network pull
actions.completion_effect: Permits one isolated local platform verification; plain PostgreSQL is not a substitute and no remote mutation is authorized.

actions.summary: Run the untrusted parser under an approved isolation primitive and attest OS-level process, filesystem, network and resource containment.
prerequisites: supported sandbox platform with approved policy
authorized security operator
noncustomer adversarial fixtures
actions.completion_effect: Permits parser-isolation re-verification only; it does not enable customer processing.

actions.summary: Provision an approved off-host immutable destination, transfer authorized encrypted bytes and complete a witnessed restore and reconciliation drill.
prerequisites: approved custody provider and retention policy
managed encryption-key ownership
authorized source inventory and restore target
evidence_required: destination receipt bound to exact byte hashes
restored-byte hash comparison and audit continuity
actions.completion_effect: Permits off-host custody verification only; it does not prove production RPO/RTO or authorize delivery.

non_claims: Every action is a genuine human or external prerequisite; unresolved local engineering is reported elsewhere.
Completing an action permits only the named gate to be re-verified and never causes automatic activation.
No path, hash, prepared package, template or generated test signature is treated as human review, external delivery or receipt.
All zero and NO truth values remain unchanged until genuine evidence is verified through the canonical workflow.
